verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public API with OpenAPI specs, versioning, and authentication. The pack shows calls, messages, contacts and listing existing inboxes, but nothing about endpoints to search available numbers, purchase them, or configure them programmatically. Number acquisition is only described as a plan entitlement and in-app setup, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, buy, and configure phone numbers through a documented API
